_note: STATE 12 / E5. The node set is DERIVED from reference/screen-registry.csv — this file may not add or drop a state, and tools/stategraph.mjs fails the run if it does. The edge set is AUTHORED WITH EVIDENCE: every transition cites a file:line into the frozen bytes, and the tool resolves the citation. An unevidenced arrow looks like a spec and is a guess.

S-SIGN-01.note: Entry point of the unauthenticated area. Success leaves this flow into ⟂HOME-01, which is a boundary rather than a state of this screen.

happy.note: Default entry. Submit is inert until both fields carry content (D1 is a guard on the affordance, not a branch).

loading.note: aria-busy, label swapped, second submit impossible.

error{invalid-credentials}.note: Identifier preserved, focus on the secret, announced via a role=alert container that pre-exists in the DOM (o-s5).

locked{rate-limited}.note: TERMINAL AT SCREEN LEVEL, not a dead end. No in-screen transition changes it — the window elapses off-screen, and the way out is the reset route, which leaves for S-SIGN-02. That cross-screen edge is navgraph's to draw, not this machine's. The banner renders the ASSUMED 15-minute window (o-s1, debt #1). Flagged rather than left to report as S7 every run: a suppressed advisory teaches a reader to skim.

offline.note: Distinguished from a rejected credential by copy only — ds-banner has no offline variant (Extension Note 1).

transitions.trigger: submit with both fields non-empty (D1, D2)
D2 no — request did not reach the service
entry on a URL hook — QA and review path
entry on a URL hook — QA and review path
entry on a URL hook — QA and review path

S-SIGN-02.note: Reached by PUSH from S-SIGN-01, so its toolbar back is correct. Carries the identifier already typed (AC4.2).

happy.note: Identifier pre-filled from S-SIGN-01 when one was typed.

error{invalid-email}.note: The ONLY error this branch may show. There is deliberately no account-exists branch (D-f2) — adding one would build an enumeration oracle.

transitions.trigger: submit with a well-formed identifier (D4 yes)
submit with a malformed identifier (D4 no)
D5 no — request did not reach the service

S-SIGN-03.note: Reached by REPLACE (D-f3), which is why it carries an explicit route back instead of relying on browser back. The toolbar back that proto-signin-01 had here was superseded by rev-signin-01 / CR3.

happy.note: Names the address the link was sent to (AC5.1).

success{resent}.note: role=status rather than role=alert — a confirmation should not interrupt.

error{resend-throttled}.note: The resend control is DISABLED here, not merely captioned. rev-signin-01 / CR2 — copy is not the mechanism.

transitions.trigger: resend outside the throttle window (D6 no)
resend inside the throttle window (D6 yes)
